text: Added GigaChat4-37B-A4B (37B MoE, hybrid attention); moved to tinyleague.org, added Discord.
Added Maxwell-V1-Flash (35B MoE, block-sparse) and Raon-1-mini (29B MoE, Korean).
Added Aleph-Alpha/Kolibri-1.1 (75B sparse-attention MoE) and Ling-3.2-air (124B MoE, vision).
Added gemma-4-26B-A4B-it (25B MoE, vision); theme toggle with live system detection.
Added Inkling-2-Mini; loop-aware KV cache; newest-first heatmap; Core pins DeepSWE 1.1, AutomationBench.
Added OVHaiLLM/Olala-v1.0-mini-7A1B; dropped North-Mini-Code and diffusiongemma.
Added tencent/Hy4-flash, a 220B MoE multimodal model with 12B active parameters.
Added SenseNova/SenseNova-Loop-9B, a 9.4B looped-transformer multimodal model.
Mobile layout: compact model cards, section menu, heatmap swipe hint, readable scatter labels.
Added Nanbeige/Nanbeige4.3-33B; estimated decode speed, a Speed preset and sticky Models headers.
v2 redesign: core heatmap, shareable filters, KV-cache column, HLE/IFBench scatter presets; added Spark-X2.6-1.7B, dropped KAT-Coder.
Added LiquidAI/LFM3-1.7B; lowered the param floor to 1.5B.
Added Sage-A1.5, GPQA/Terminal-Bench scatter charts, and τ²/τ³-bench scores.

Added XHToken/Spark-X2.6-4B (4.1B dense) and dropped the superseded Spark-X2.5-4B. Added ornith-ai/Ornith-1.5-122B (125B MoE, 8B active, vision) and LiquidAI/LFM2.5-24B-A2B (24B MoE, 2B active). Removed the two oldest entries, Nemotron-3-Nano-Omni-30B-A3B-Reasoning and tencent/Hy-MT2-30B-A3B. The coverage heatmap now hides benchmark columns with fewer than two entries as soon as a filter is applied.
Added nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL-120B-A12B-BF16 and nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-74B-A9B-BF16. Re-based the AA Intelligence Index on v4.3.2 and re-fetched every model.
Added openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-35B-A3B (35.2B MoE, vision) — first open-source on-device MoE VLM. Scores from the model card's eval figures (instruct, 4x visual-token compression).
Added IFM/K2-Horizon-3.7B. All K2 Horizon models are now on Artificial Analysis: added the AA Intelligence Index (v4.3) to K2-Horizon-3.7B (16), K2-Horizon-7B (21) and K2-Horizon-MoVA-36B-A4B (26).
Fixed duplicate benchmark scores (highest shown, conflicts logged), AA fetcher matching, and vision/param detection for new models.
Added Agnes-AI/Agnes-3.0-Flash (33.1B dense, vision). Added a License column to the Models table.
Added inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-flash-VL (124.8B MoE, vision) and meta-models/Muse-Glimmer-30B (29.8B dense, vision).
Added nex-agi/Nex-N2.5-mini (35.1B MoE, vision). Added a model filter. Fixed the mobile layout (tables now scroll horizontally, heatmap keeps the model column pinned).
Removed the Fara family (and JetBrains/Mellum2-12B); benchmark columns now show specific versions, grouped by family.
Added openbmb/MiniCPM5-2B (2.5B dense), IFM K2-Horizon-MoVA-36B-A4B (36B MoE, 4B active) and K2-Horizon-7B (9B dense).
Initial release with 26 open-weight models.
